(ISW daily campaign assessment; cross-ref Bloomberg refinery-strike reporting)
Cross-ref URL: https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-08-13/ukraine-says-it-hit-oil-refinery-in-russia-s-urals-region

Ukraine–Russia — ISW assessment (20 Aug 2026) and refinery-strike reporting:
- Russian forces launched a massive combined drone-and-missile strike against Ukraine,
  continuing a pattern of stockpiling ballistic and cruise missiles for several days to
  amass enough for major attacks causing significant civilian casualties.
- Russian forces recently advanced in northern Sumy Oblast and in the Pokrovsk direction.
- Russian aerial drones penetrated Moldovan and Romanian airspace, and a Russian naval drone
  was destroyed close to a Romanian natural-gas platform on 20 August — demonstrating the
  Kremlin has accepted the risk that its war will cause damage to other states, including
  NATO members.
- Russia continues to set conditions to augment strike packages with North Korean missiles,
  including upgraded KN-30 ballistic missiles.
- Ukrainian forces continued their long-range strike campaign against Russian oil
  infrastructure. Ukraine struck an oil refinery in Russia's Bashkortostan region (Ufa) on
  20 August, sparking a fire; the Ufa refineries are operated by Bashneft, a subsidiary of
  Rosneft. Ukraine has hit most of Russia's refineries in recent months, causing acute fuel
  shortages in parts of the country.
